nodes: States made on the basis of language
props.label: p.54

scenes.narration: After more than 200 years under British rule, India became independent on 15 August 1947. For better administration, it was divided into states on the basis of language. Today India has 28 states and 8 union territories.

nodes: State: has its own duly elected state government
Union territory: under the direct administration of the Union Government
props.label: p.55

scenes.narration: A state has its own duly elected state government. A union territory is under the direct administration of the Union Government.
India’s capital is New Delhi. Rajasthan is the largest state and Goa is the smallest state. Every state and union territory has its own capital, in the table on page 54.

questions.prompt: A union territory has its own elected state government.
questions.explanation: A union territory is under the direct administration of the Union Government (p.55).
